spans.s: क्व᳙ ind. (fr. 1. कु, Pāṇ. v, 3, 12; v, 2, 105) loc. of 2. क॑ = कस्मिन्, or कतरस्मिन्, Mn. x, 66 (क्व श्रेयस्-त्वम्, in whom is the preference?), Kathās. lxxxiii, 36
where? in what place? whither? RV. (sometimes connected with particles अ॑ह, इ॑द्, इव, स्वि॑द्) &c.
(connected with नु), Nal.; Mālav.
(with नु खलु), Śak.
(with √ भू, √ अस्) how is it with? what has become of? i.e. it is done with, RV. i, 161, 4; vii, 88, 5; AV. x, 8, 7; ŚBr.; Pāṇ. iii, 1, 12,
Vārtt. 1
, Pat.
(with गत) how is it with? Nal.; Daś. (क्व गतस् तव मय्य् अनुरागः, what has become of your affection for me ?)
or क्व alone may have the same meaning (e. g. क्व सुखम्, where is happiness? i.e. there is no such thing as happiness, Śāntiś.), Pañcat.; Naiṣ. i, 20
(after a negative phrase) how much less? R. i, 67, 10

— क्व or कुत्र-क्व (implying excessive incongruity) where is this? where is that? how distant is this from that? how little does this agree with that? (e.g. क्व सूर्य-प्रभवो वंशः क्व चाल्प-विषया मतिः, how can my limited intellect describe the solar race? Ragh. i, 2), MBh.; R. &c.
क्वापि, anywhere, somewhere, to some place, in a certain place, Nal.; Pañcat.; Kathās.
sometimes, Sāh.; Hit.
क्व च, nowhere, never, BhP. iv, 29, 64
क्व चन, nowhere, MBh. xiv, 560

anywhere, somewhere, to any place, in a certain place, Mn.; R.; Śak. &c.

अपि न id., Megh.
